title.en: Unify Course and Course room terminology
title.zh: 统一课程与课程教室术语

purpose.en: Replace user-facing Class and Classroom wording on smartlingo.net with Course and Course room while retaining compatible internal routes and data identifiers.
purpose.zh: 将 smartlingo.net 面向用户的班级与课堂术语统一为课程与课程教室，同时保留兼容的内部路由和数据标识。

en: Public, Referred course, and Private replace the previous course-type wording.
Course room replaces Classroom in visible navigation, cards, forms, sharing, and management.
zh: 课程类型统一为公开、推荐课程和私有。
导航、卡片、表单、分享和管理界面统一使用课程教室。

en: Change only user-visible terminology; preserve legacy class routes, schema columns, CSS hooks, and storage keys.
Rename the former trial/join type label to Referred course.
Add an additive migration that updates reserved public demo titles to Course.
Update regression contracts for the shared vocabulary.
zh: 仅修改面向用户的术语，保留旧 class 路由、数据库字段、CSS hook 和存储键。
将原试学加入类型标签改为推荐课程。
新增可追加迁移，将保留的公共演示标题更新为课程。
更新共享词汇回归门禁。

en: Shared site policy and architecture audits passed.
Cross-site terminology scan found no remaining visible Class or Classroom wording.
Site build and regression contracts passed before publication.
zh: 共享网站规则和架构审计通过。
跨站术语扫描未发现残留的可见 Class 或 Classroom 文案。
发布前通过本站构建与回归门禁。
本次术语一致性范围内没有延期项目。

en: Keep smartlingo.net identity, data, configuration, routes, and deployment resources independent.
zh: 保持 smartlingo.net 的身份、数据、配置、路由和部署资源完全独立。
